senses.gloss: m. (v. צָדוֹק2) Sadducee, a member of the sect of the Sadducees, opp. to Pharisee (פָּרוּשׁ).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 19b:2">Yoma 19ᵇ</cite> <he>חשדוהו צ׳</he> they suspected him to be a Sadducee.

<cite ref="Yoma 19b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מעשה בצ׳ אחד וכ׳</he> it happened with a Saducee (acting as high priest on the Day of Atonement) that he prepared the frankincense without &c.; (Tosef. ib. I, 8 <cite ref="B00759"><he>ביתוסי</he></cite>).
Nidd. 33ᵇ מעשה בצ׳ אחד; Tosef. ib. V, 3 בצדוקה אחת (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. צְדוּקִים, צְדוּקִין.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 5:2">Ab. d’R. N. ch. V</cite> <he>צ׳ על שם צדוק</he> the sect of the Sadducees was named from Zadok.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:2">Tosef. Nidd. V, 2</cite> <he>בנות הצ׳</he> the Sadducean women; <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:2">Nidd. IV, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:35">Tosef. Ḥag. III, 35</cite>; Y. ib. III, end, 79ᵈ.
Hor. 4ᵃ דבר שהצ׳ מודין בו a decision with which the Sadducees would have agreed; a. fr.—V. מִין III.—Fem. צְדוּקִית; pl. צְדוּקִיּוֹת.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:3">Tosef. Nidd. V, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Niddah 33b:59">Nidd. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>נשי צדוקים</he>).
